name: B10-0085/2026 (S&D) – Conviction and imminent sentencing of Jimmy Lai in Hong Kong
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the conviction and imminent sentencing of Jimmy Lai in Hong Kong
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns the conviction of Hong Kong publisher Jimmy Lai and calls for his immediate release. It says the charges against him punish the peaceful use of free speech and a free press. It asks Hong Kong and Chinese authorities to drop the charges, respect fair trials and judicial independence, and change laws that break international human rights standards. It also asks the European Union and its member states to keep raising his case and consider measures against those responsible.

- The Parliament asks for Jimmy Lai's release and for all charges against him to be dropped.
- It calls on Hong Kong and China to respect fair trials and free speech.
- The European Union is urged to raise his case and consider measures against those responsible.
